blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — About 1,500 second-year students of Goldenstate College in General Santos City attended a campus security seminar on Tuesday to help them recognize potential risks, report safety concerns, and respond during emergencies. The five-day Security Awareness Seminar focused on campus safety, crime prevention, and emergency preparedness, with personnel of the General Santos City Police Office (GSCPO) serving as resource speakers on the third day. Organizers said the seminar seeks to build a safer, more alert school community by giving students practical knowledge in dealing with security concerns.
